body: ### Contributing guidelines - [x] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) - [x] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) - [x] I have updated 'mini.nvim' to latest version of the `main` branch ### Module(s) mini.completion, mini.snippets ### Neovim version 0.11.x ### Description I came across this error when using mini.completion and mini.snippets with svelte language server. ### Reproduction 1. Make sure to have nodejs, npm and svelte-language-server installed. I use arch btw 😏 ~~in WSL2~~, so with arch using yay ``yay -Syu --noconfirm svelte-language-server nodejs-lts npm`` does the job. 2. Below is the config to use to reproduce the issue. ```lua -- Clone latest 'mini.nvim' (requires Git CLI installed) vim.cmd('echo "Installing `mini.nvim`" | redraw') local mini_path = vim.fn.stdpath("data") .. "/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim" local clone_cmd = { "git", "clone", "--depth=1", "https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim", mini_path } vim.fn.system(clone_cmd) vim.cmd('echo "`mini.nvim` is installed" | redraw') -- Make sure 'mini.nvim' is available vim.cmd("packadd mini.nvim") require("mini.deps").setup() require("mini.snippets").setup() require("mini.completion").setup() MiniDeps.add("neovim/nvim-lspconfig") local lsp_servers = { svelte = { settings = { typescript = { inlayHints = { parameterNames = { enabled = "all" }, parameterTypes = { enabled = true }, variableTypes = { enabled = true }, propertyDeclarationTypes = { enabled = true }, functionLikeReturnTypes = { enabled = true }, enumMemberValues = { enabled = true }, }, }, }, }, } vim.lsp.config("*", { capabilities = lsp_capabilities, root_markers = { ".git" }, }) for server, config in pairs(lsp_servers) do vim.lsp.config(server, config) vim.lsp.enable(server) end ``` 3. Clone this repo ``https://github.com/231tr0n/231tr0n.github.io.git``. 4. Navigate into the git root directory. 5. Run ``npm install`` to install all packages. This step is necessary for the svelte language server to work, as it does not seem to work properly without installing all the packages. 6. Run ``NVIM_APPNAME=repro nvim -- src/routes/+layout.svelte``. 7. Go to line number 5 and press `o` to create a new line 6. 8. Type ``import ass`` and press `Ctrl-n` to select the first element in the completion menu named ``asset`` and press `Enter` to get the error.

Hmm... As this has occurred with different LSP servers and one of them checked their source code without luck, I do indeed wonder if this is somehow an issue with 'mini.completion' or Neovim itself. I'll take another look.

All right, I've taken another look and it still doesn't look like an issue with 'mini.completion' or Neovim, but rather a server.

Although today I can not reproduce the different `textEdit` (which is *very* weird and might have been a mistake on my part, but I still doubt that somehow), the return values from the server I have today still cause the error described in this issue.

Here is a full repro steps I did:

- Apply the following patch to 'lua/mini/completion.lua':

    <details><summary>'mini.completion' logging patch</summary>

    ```diff
    diff --git a/lua/mini/completion.lua b/lua/mini/completion.lua
    index af44db34..8ddce5c6 100644
    --- a/lua/mini/completion.lua
    +++ b/lua/mini/completion.lua
    @@ -1190,7 +1190,12 @@ H.make_completion_request = function()
       -- handle possible fallback and to have all completion suggestions be later
       -- filtered with one `base`. Anyway, the most common situation is with one
       -- attached LSP client.
    +  table.insert(_G.log, { state = 'before textDocument/completion', line = vim.fn.getline(vim.fn.line('.')) })
       local cancel_fun = vim.lsp.buf_request_all(buf_id, 'textDocument/completion', params, function(result)
    +    table.insert(
    +      _G.log,
    +      { state = 'textDocument/completion', line = vim.fn.getline(vim.fn.line('.')), result = vim.deepcopy(result) }
    +    )
         if not H.is_lsp_current(H.completion, current_id) then return end
     
         H.completion.lsp.status = 'received'
    @@ -1479,7 +1484,9 @@ H.info_window_lines = function(info_id)
       H.info.lsp.id = current_id
       H.info.lsp.status = 'sent'
     
    +  table.insert(_G.log, { state = 'before resolve', item = vim.deepcopy(lsp_data.item) })
       local cancel_fun = H.client_request(client, 'completionItem/resolve', lsp_data.item, function(err, result, _)
    +    table.insert(_G.log, { state = 'completionItem/resolve', item = vim.deepcopy(result) })
         -- Don't do anything if there is other LSP request in action
         if not H.is_lsp_current(H.info, current_id) then return end
     
    @@ -1503,6 +1510,8 @@ H.info_window_lines = function(info_id)
       return false
     end
     
    +_G.log = {}
    +
     H.info_window_options = function()
       local win_config = H.get_config().window.info
       local default_border = (vim.fn.exists('+winborder') == 1 and vim.o.winborder ~= '') and vim.o.winborder or 'single'
    ```

    </details>

- Use the following '~/.config/nvim-repro/init.lua':

    <details><summary>Repro init.lua</summary>

    ```lua
    -- Clone latest 'mini.nvim' (requires Git CLI installed)
    vim.cmd('echo "Installing `mini.nvim`" | redraw')
    local mini_path = vim.fn.stdpath("data") .. "/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim"
    local clone_cmd = { "git", "clone", "https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim", mini_path }
    vim.fn.system(clone_cmd)
    vim.cmd('echo "`mini.nvim` is installed" | redraw')

    -- Make sure 'mini.nvim' is available
    vim.cmd("packadd mini.nvim")
    require("mini.deps").setup()
    require("mini.snippets").setup()
    require("mini.completion").setup({ delay = { completion = 500, info = 500 } })

    MiniDeps.add("neovim/nvim-lspconfig")
    MiniDeps.add("mason-org/mason.nvim")
    require('mason').setup()

    local lsp_servers = {
      svelte = {
        settings = {
          typescript = {
            inlayHints = {
              parameterNames = { enabled = "all" },
              parameterTypes = { enabled = true },
              variableTypes = { enabled = true },
              propertyDeclarationTypes = { enabled = true },
              functionLikeReturnTypes = { enabled = true },
              enumMemberValues = { enabled = true },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    }

    vim.lsp.config("*", {
      capabilities = MiniCompletion.get_lsp_capabilities(),
      root_markers = { ".git" },
    })
    for server, config in pairs(lsp_servers) do
      vim.lsp.config(server, config)
      vim.lsp.enable(server)
    end

    -- For easier demo
    require('mini.misc').setup()
    require('mini.splitjoin').setup()
    vim.o.wrap = false
    vim.lsp.set_log_level('TRACE')
    ```

    </details>

- Set up `https://github.com/231tr0n/231tr0n.github.io.git` as described in the issue and navigate to it.
- Adjust 'src/routes/+layout.svelte' to start with the following lines for cleaner logs (all other lines are the same; there is a space after fifth `import `):

    ```svelte
    <script lang="ts">
    	import Navbar from '$lib/components/Navbar.svelte';
    	import Footer from '$lib/components/Footer.svelte';
    	import { page } from '$app/state';
    	import { fly } from 'svelte/transition';
    	import 
    ```

- Start Neovim as `NVIM_APPNAME=nvim-repro nvim -- src/routes/+layout.svelte`.
- Execute `:Mason` ans install `svelte-language-server`. I got version `0.17.19`.
- Exit and start Neovim in the same way.
- Wait for LSP server to initialize (semantic tokens start to appear).
- Type `5j`, `A`. Relatively quickly type `ass` and wait for completion to appear.
- Press `<C-n>` twice (relatively quickly) and wait for info to appear.
- Press `<CR>`. It now inserts snippet item correctly, but before ccd7aed28060cb58b7205d0ef02fcaec699d4847 it shows error (can be checked by reverting changes from that commit and redo the repro).
- See `_G.log`. Its entries for `label = "asset"` contain the following `textEdit`:

    ```
    textEdit = {
      newText = "{ asset$1 } from '\\$app/paths';",
      range = {
        start = { line = 5, character = 8 }
        ["end"] = { line = 5, character = 12 },
      }
    }
    ```

    The same `textEdit` appears both before and after 'completionItem/resolve' request. The data is the same both in the manual `_G.log` and in the '~/.local/state/nvim-repro/lsp.log' (all four instances of completion item with `label = "asset"`, which includes two responses from the server).

The problem here is that at the time of the initial request the line is `\timport ass` **which is 11 characters wide** (`\t` is a single tab character) which means that the position immediately to the right of `ass` should be `character = 11` and not `character = 12`.

Here is a demo:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6546dc6e-18c8-4b12-82fc-3e865d040575
